How to Download KEA Result 2026?

Candidates can check KEA PGCET results online. They need a PGCET number and date of birth to log in. Follow the steps below to check the result.

  • Visit official website @cetonline.karnataka.gov.in
  • Click on Karnataka PGCET Results online
  • Enter PGCET number and date of birth
  • Click on submit button
  • Check result and download scorecard

Details Mentioned on PGCET Result 2026

KEA Karnataka PGCET Results contains important details about candidates. Candidates should check all details carefully. The result generally includes the following details

  • Name of Candidate
  • Registration Number
  • Category
  • Course
  • Marks Obtained
  • Merit Rank

Karnataka PG Counselling 2026

Karnataka PG Counselling 2026 will be conducted by Karnataka Examination Authority (KEA). Candidates who qualify through PGCET can take part in the counselling process. The process includes document verification, registration and option entry. Seats are allotted based on merit rank and seat availability. Candidates should keep requisite documents ready for the counselling process.
